title: Ammavin Kaipesi
desc: A mother clings to a simple mobile phone as her only link to her estranged children, longing to bridge the emotional distance that time and misunderstandings have caused.

title: Maranthen Mannithen
desc: Malli and Chitra live a happily married life in the village of Bangarappeta. Their life takes a tragic turn when they are forced to survive a devastating flood of the Godavari river.

title: Thanga Magan
desc: Arun's peaceful life is shattered when he discovers that he's adopted, sending him on a challenging journey to learn the truth about his real mother, Veda and his past.

title: Sivasakthi
desc: Sakthi, a police officer, befriends Siva, a smuggler, in order to gain his trust and get evidence against him. But soon, their friendship turns into a genuine one.

title: Unnai Ninaithu
desc: Despite Nirmala's decision to thwart his feelings, Surya helps her achieve her goals. Although when she confesses her love for him, Surya makes a startling disclosure.
